output.headline: UPMC has bought only in the target's own sub-sector, closed every deal, and has US$27.7 billion of revenue behind a Midwest entry.
output.differentiator: Second-deepest record in the target's own sub-sector (3 deals, behind only Advocate Health's 5), with every deal closed, a 100% close rate matched only by Advocate Health and Intermountain Health.

acquirer_overview.title: A US$27.7 billion-revenue health system with a clean, small deal record
points: Strategic buyer with revenue of US$27.7 billion (2023); hospitals in Pennsylvania, Maryland and New York, and Washington Health System merged in 2024. [P:1, P:2]
Three deals between 2018 and 2020, all control transactions, all closed. [T:record, K:closed_share, K:control_share]
No deals since 2022, a slight factor against it in the likelihood ranking. [K:recent, S:recency]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Its entire deal history sits in the target's own sub-sector
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor in its likelihood: 3 deals there, 0 in adjacent provider sub-sectors. [S:sector_share, K:by_sub_sector]
The target's 16.8% margin is close to what UPMC usually buys, a strong factor for. [S:margin_fit, X:target]
Third on the priority list, with a 4.7% likelihood across 107 buyers scored; no past deal in the Midwest. [R:rank, T:record]

precedent_activity.title: Three closed sub-sector deals, 2018 to 2020, at 11.3x to 17.0x
points: Principal Behavioral Health: $444M bolt-on acquisition, 2019, at 11.7x EV/EBITDA, its largest deal. [D:MA-2019-0090]
Sterling Care Network: $55M strategic acquisition, 2020, at 11.3x EV/EBITDA. [D:MA-2020-0312]
Keystone Behavioral Health: $33M recapitalization, 2018, at 17.0x EV/EBITDA. [D:MA-2018-0486]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible, but above UPMC's own record
points: Across 70 comparable deals, EV/EBITDA runs from 10.7x (25th) to 15.3x (75th), median 12.8x. [V:comps]
The 75th percentile is defensible: the target's 16.8% margin beats the comparable median of 12.9%. [V:comps, X:target]
UPMC's median paid is 11.7x, so it must stretch; synergy headroom of $15M-$25M supports that. [T:record, V:synergy]

risk_flags.title: No Midwest footprint, quiet since 2020
risk_flags.concern: No deal in the target's region, and none since 2022. [T:record, K:recent]
risk_flags.mitigant: All 3 deals closed, all in the target's own sub-sector. [K:closed_share]
risk_flags.reality: Regional entry is untested; recent inactivity is a slight factor against. [S:recency]

risk_flags.title: Price gap to the comparable range
risk_flags.concern: Median paid of 11.7x is below the 12.8x comparable median. [V:comps]
risk_flags.mitigant: Synergy headroom of $15M-$25M and US$27.7 billion revenue give capacity. [V:synergy]
risk_flags.reality: Only the $33M Keystone deal, at 17.0x, priced above 15.3x. [D:MA-2018-0486]

risk_flags.title: Competitive process
risk_flags.concern: Advocate Health has 5 sub-sector deals; Welsh Carson and GTCR have 6 Midwest deals each. [T:record]
risk_flags.reality: Advocate Health's median paid is 13.8x against UPMC's 11.7x. [T:record]

conviction.rationale: Basis: 3 deals in the target's own sub-sector and 0 in adjacent provider sub-sectors, plus third place on the priority list. No Midwest deal is neutral. [T:record, R:rank, C:conviction]
